text: While a contagious disease ravages the world, Paul, Sarah and their teenage son Travis live deep in the woods, behind a single locked entrance. After they burn the body of Sarah's father, a stranger named Will breaks in, and Paul [ties him to a tree with a bag over his head|images|ropes, cages and executions] to see if he is sick. The two families settle in together, but a barking dog, an open door and Travis's nightmares [turn each family against the other|threat|people in your own life], as [no one can be sure who carries the sickness|rules|it passes to others].
